zh.title: 任务没搬走，账本为什么已经写着‘进入审查’？
zh.summary: 一次受控提交报错后，任务仍在执行目录，文件头却已标记为待审。我们对照重试与丢失回执，研究多 Agent 系统如何证明状态转换真正完成。

en.title: A Confirmed Submission Still Needs Process Evidence
en.summary: Draft confirmation constrains submitted content and authority. A reported counterexample and internal statistical reanalysis show why process fulfillment and mechanism benefits need separate evidence boundaries.
